title: ClinLens: Towards Long-Horizon Coding Agents for Longitudinal Multimodal Clinical Data Science
description:
arXiv:2607.26155v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Clinical data-science agents must transform heterogeneous longitudinal records into auditable analyses, yet existing benchmarks largely isolate medical question answering, structured-table reasoning, or generic scientific repositories. We introduce CLINLENS, a benchmark of 200 executable tasks over five linked MIMIC resources spanning structured electronic health records, notes, electrocardiograms, chest radiographs, and echocardiograms.
